nature_language: 当前位置北京。我和两个朋友计划去深圳玩三天，选择火车出行，市内交通方式为地铁。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Beijing. My two friends and I are planning to visit Shenzhen for three days. We have chosen to travel by train and use subway for intra-city transportation. Please provide me with a travel itinerary.
